description: The REVTeX source, figures and compiled PDF of the paper Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes, the Lean 4 certificate lean/HodgeClosure.lean (sixty-two theorems: fifty-two axiom-free, two on propext and Quot.sound, eight on propext), and the Python, Julia, C, C++ and shell programs that recompute every finite quantity used in the proofs (code/run_all.sh). The paper proves that the Hodge conjecture is equivalent to two statements about abelian varieties, that for each the known locus is dense and either everything or meagre, proves the real multiplications by sqrt 6 and by the cubic fields Q(zeta_7)^+ and Q(zeta_9)^+ algebraic on explicit families of K3 surfaces, proves that the fibrewise isogenies of the one-dimensional Fricke families of levels 5 and 7 are complex multiplications by Q(sqrt -5) and Q(sqrt -7), the sign of their square being decided by the twisting function under the Fricke involution, so that the Hodge conjecture holds on every power and every Hilbert scheme of every member, reduces the Hodge conjecture for all powers of the surfaces with totally real endomorphism field to their exceptional classes and proves it, with (F3'), for every power and Hilbert scheme of a K3 surface of Kummer type over Q (an explicit condition on the Hasse invariants of the transcendental lattice at Picard numbers 17 and 18), computes the transcendental spaces of the Fricke surfaces as U^2 + <-1> + <-N>, so that their Kuga-Satake varieties are fourth powers of an abelian fourfold of Q(sqrt -N)-Weil type of discriminant one, isogenous to the product of an elliptic curve with complex multiplication by Q(sqrt -N) and a simple threefold, builds the first object each statement needs, and at the point of complex multiplication E_0^6 bounds dim Ext^2 by isolated Ext blocks for every twisting cochain, which settles every placement of thirty-five pieces, shows that one threefold piece outside every closed chain of Ext blocks fails the criterion, which settles every further piece of positive twist within one shift of the thirty-two threefolds, proves for every polarisation of E_0^6 that a convolution of distinct threefolds and at most five line bundles at any twists fails the criterion, enumerates the arrangements of six, seven and eight line bundles (six and seven fail, eight outside thirty-one arrangements), and reads the support of an object meeting the criterion off the obstruction class localised to that support: the rest of the support cuts a threefold of nonzero multiplicity in an ample divisor, two threefolds meeting along a surface carry nothing between them, no object supported on the thirty-two threefolds of one family has the polarised shape, and a smooth complete intersection meeting the threefolds in curves cannot carry the rest; what remains at that point are eight or more line bundles, with or without threefolds, and the supports mixing the two families of threefolds, decided by the products along their chains. The candidate configurations were proposed by the Anaxia engine of the BLLM project (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23469389), the support results by its release 3.1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23484160), and all are decided by the proofs and the programs. Neither statement is proved and the conjecture is not claimed. The folder preprints holds the compiled paper only.
